name: Dremel 3D50 0.4 nozzle
machine_start_gcode:
M106 P1 S0 ; Set THR fan based on slicer fan speed setting
M106 P2 S0 ; Set Side_fan based on slicer fan speed setting
M106 P3 S0 ; Set Filter_fan based on slicer fan speed setting
M106 S0
M140 S{first_layer_bed_temperature[0]} ; Set bed temperature
M190 S{first_layer_bed_temperature[0]} ; Wait for bed to reach temperature
M104 S{first_layer_temperature[0]} ; Set extruder temperature
LAYERS=[total_layer_count]

; Other start G-code commands
G28 ; Home all axes
;BED_MESH_CALIBRATE ; Start bed mesh calibration
;G29 ; Auto bed leveling (if applicable)
G1 Z5 F3000 ; Move the platform down 5mm
G1 X0 Y0 F3000 ; Move the extruder to the starting position
M104 S{first_layer_temperature[0]} ; Set extruder temperature
M109 S{first_layer_temperature[0]} ; Wait for extruder to reach temperature

; Purge the extruder
G92 E0 ; Reset the extruder
G1 Z2.0 F3000 ; Move Z Axis up
G1 X0 Y200 Z0.3 F5000.0 ; Move to start position
G1 X0 Y20.0 Z0.3 F1500.0 E35 ; Draw the first line
;G1 X0 Y200.0 Z0.3 F5000.0 ; Move to side a little
;G1 X0 Y20 Z0.3 F1500.0 E30 ; Draw the second line
G92 E0 ; Reset the extruder
G1 Z2.0 F3000 ; Move Z Axis up
G1 X5 Y20 Z0.3 F5000.0 ; Move over to prevent blob squish
G92 E0 ; Reset the extruder again
G1 F1500 E-0.8 ; Retract a bit
machine_end_gcode:
; End G-code
;SET_FAN_SPEED FAN=THR SPEED=0 ; Turn off THR fan
;SET_FAN_SPEED FAN=Side_fan SPEED=0 ; Turn off Side_fan
;SET_FAN_SPEED FAN=Filter_fan SPEED=0 ; Turn off Filter_fan
G1 Z256 X10 Y10 F3000 ; Move Z up and retract filament more

; Other end G-code commands
M104 S0 ; Turn off extruder heater
M400


M140 S0 ; Turn off bed heater
G91 ; Relative positioning
G1 E-0.2 F3000 ; Retract the filament slightly

;# Set the fan to the initial speed
SET_FAN_SPEED FAN=Filter_fan SPEED=0.5
M400 ; Wait for moves to finish   
SET_FAN_SPEED FAN=Filter_fan SPEED=0.3 ;Set to your desired lower speed
G4 P60000 ; Wait for 60 seconds    
SET_FAN_SPEED FAN=Filter_fan SPEED=0
SET_FAN_SPEED FAN=Aux_fan SPEED=0
